notes.title: Stability update and price change
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue with the game crashing exactly 60 seconds after launching on some systems.
The hidden cheat code menu now has the codes listed.
New 50% lower regular price.

notes.title: Bugfixes
notes.notes:
Fixed a couple small bugs:
* Circular mazes should no longer have their central circle entrances blocked by certain traps
* Fixed an issue with enemies not spawning in square mazes in custom maps
